Implement Spring Boot 3 authentication service and REST controller:
1. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/service/AuthService.java:
   - Password hashing using BCrypt (or MessageDigest dummy comparison on unknown user to resist timing attacks).
   - Simple in-memory attempt tracking for rate-limiting.
   - JWT generation using standard HMAC-SHA256 (java.security / javax.crypto Mac) with expiration configurable via 'kaapstyle.jwt.secret'.
   - register(RegisterRequest): checks duplicate email (throws Conflict / 409), saves user, returns AuthResponse.
   - login(LoginRequest): checks user exists & password matches, returns AuthResponse, throws 401 on bad credentials.
2. backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/controller/AuthController.java:
   - @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/auth') with @CrossOrigin.
   - @PostMapping('/register') with @Valid RegisterRequest returning ResponseEntity<AuthResponse> (201 Created or 200 OK).
   - @PostMapping('/login') with @Valid LoginRequest returning ResponseEntity<AuthResponse>.
   - @ExceptionHandler methods for IllegalArgumentException (400), BadCredentials / Unauthorized (401), and Conflict (409).
